result.title: Text-Assisted Event Stream Visual Place Recognition via Multi-Scale Spatiotemporal Optimal Transport
result.comment: 17 pages including appendix, 4 figures. Submitted to ICLR 2027
result.summary: Benefiting from the high dynamic range, high temporal resolution, and low energy consumption of event cameras, low-altitude economic research leveraging event cameras has become a popular topic. Several existing attempts introduce natural-language descriptions into visual place recognition (VPR) to mitigate the sparsity of structural spatial information inherent to event cameras. Nevertheless, these methods still fail to fully address two core challenges: effectively encoding event streams and semantically aligning event streams with text. In this paper, we propose a multi-scale spatial-temporal optimal transport approach, MSTOT-EPR, to address these challenges. Specifically, given event streams and scene text information, we first adopt a visual encoder and a text encoder to extract respective feature representations. We then apply optimal-transport constraints to achieve cross-modal alignment. We then design a cross-modal bottleneck fusion module to further fuse bimodal features. Furthermore, we develop multi-scale spatial optimal transport and inter-frame temporal optimal transport modules to mine high-quality spatial-temporal event features for scene recognition. Extensive experiments on the NYC-Event-VPR and EPRBench datasets fully validate the effectiveness of our proposed framework for event-based VPR. The source code of this paper will be released upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MSTOT-EPR：用视觉与文本编码器分别提取事件流与场景文本特征，以最优传输约束做跨模态对齐，再经跨模态瓶颈融合模块，以及多尺度空间与帧间时间最优传输模块，挖掘用于事件相机视觉位置识别的时空特征。
AI.relevance_reason: 任务本身是事件流位置识别而非多模态推理，但其跨模态瓶颈融合与多尺度空间/时间最优传输对齐，可能为核查「视觉证据如何被压缩进 latent 状态、时序证据如何筛选」提供方法线索，值得进一步确认。
